description: This file defines the LibraryProvider class, which manages a user's audiobook library, including purchase status, persistence using SharedPreferences, and notifying UI updates.

classes.name: LibraryProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the user's audiobook collection, enabling purchase, persistence, and retrieval.

methods.name: LibraryProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the library by loading saved data.

methods.name: isPurchased
methods.description: Checks if a book with the given ID has been purchased.

methods.name: purchaseBook
methods.description: Adds an audiobook to the library and updates persistent storage.

methods.name: _loadLibrary
methods.description: Loads the library state from shared preferences.

methods.name: _saveLibrary
methods.description: Saves the current library state to shared preferences.
